text.aria-label: Title text 'Figure 14: Blending B0 with climatology lowers long-lead error more than any lag arm shown does'
text.tspan: Figure 14: Blending B0 with climatology lowers long-lead error more than

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Top: arms that use climatology. Bottom: lag arms. Error minus B0's in percentage points of capacity; negative beats B0. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole months. Zero is B0. Adding climatology as a column (CL) leaves the 95% interval across zero at every lead-day shown, so CL does not clearly beat B0. The climatology of every top-panel arm comes from months that include later ones, which a live service would not have.'
text.tspan: Top: arms that use climatology. Bottom: lag arms. Error minus B0's in percentage points of capacity; negative beats
B0. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole months. Zero is B0.
Adding climatology as a column (CL) leaves the 95% interval across zero at every lead-day shown, so CL does not
The climatology of every top-panel arm comes from months that include later ones, which a live service would not

text.aria-label: Title text 'Climatology is the median power of the plant's calendar month and hour from months outside the scored block (out-of-fold). W7 and Q30 read recent days. N2 reads one random day from months not being scored, and N2-3 reads three such days, giving N2-3 as many columns as W7. N2 and N2-3 therefore show what a lag with no recent information gains. Every estimate in this figure is post hoc: written after the first run's results were known. Arms. CL: B0 plus the climatology as a column. W7+CL: W7 plus the climatology as a column. B0xCL: B0 blended half and half with the climatology, with no fit. W7xCL: W7 blended half and half with the climatology, with no fit. climatology: the median power of the plant's calendar month and hour, from months outside the scored block, with no fit. W7 (the weekly statistics): the minimum, maximum, and mean of power at the same hour over the last 7 whole days. Q30: the 30-day 90th percentile and median of power at the same hour. N2: a random day from months not being scored (a null control). N2-3: three random-day lags, as wide as W7.'
text.tspan: Climatology is the median power of the plant's calendar month and hour from months outside the scored block (out-of-fold). W7
and Q30 read recent days. N2 reads one random day from months not being scored, and N2-3 reads three such days, giving N2-3
